profile.headline: Full Stack Software Engineer at Chevron
profile.summary:
I am a highly motivated and skilled Software Engineer with 3 years of experience in CI/CD DevOps development, data ingestion pipelines, front-end development with React, and API development. Throughout my career, I have demonstrated a passion for leveraging cutting-edge technologies to deliver efficient and scalable solutions.

My expertise lies in designing and implementing robust CI/CD pipelines, automating deployment processes, and ensuring smooth and continuous integration of code. I take pride in optimizing data ingestion pipelines, ensuring seamless data flow and maintaining data integrity.

In the realm of front-end development, I excel in crafting user-friendly and responsive interfaces using React, creating immersive and engaging user experiences. My keen eye for detail and commitment to delivering high-quality code result in polished and visually appealing applications.

Additionally, I possess a strong background in API development, where I design and build RESTful APIs that empower applications to communicate efficiently and securely.

As a Software Engineer, I am constantly seeking opportunities to expand my knowledge and stay up-to-date with the latest industry trends. I thrive in collaborative environments, enjoy problem-solving challenges, and always strive to deliver solutions that exceed expectations.

Feel free to reach out if you want to discuss collaboration, innovative projects, or simply share ideas in the ever-evolving world of software engineering!

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Lead in the development of the deployment tool of Power Platform Applications.
Full stack software engineer focused on developing web app tools to empower data engineers to create and publish data products. In addition to providing a service to the enterprise to host critical infrastructure report.
positions.insights: Software Design, Web Engineering and +10 skills

positions.title: PT Desktop, AV Technician 3
positions.description:
•Provide immediate technological services to faculty and staff in a timely manner by fostering an environment of open dialogue and collaborative problem solving 
•Conduct software and hardware installation and upgrades through Microsoft System Center Configuration Manager 
•Assist in redesigning of hardware and software mass deployment projects which improves the recovery times and point objective calculations for business unit applications for upwards of 500 machines
